headline: Moody's Revises Genmab Outlook to Positive on Pipeline and Debt Progress
summary: Moody's upgraded Genmab's outlook to positive, citing progress in the company's drug pipeline and successful debt reduction.
why: Credit rating outlook changes can lower borrowing costs and signal improving financial stability to institutional investors.

impacts.name: Genmab
impacts.why: A positive credit rating outlook reflects lower credit risk and improving financial fundamentals.
